title: Advanced
description: Understand long, demanding texts and their implied meaning, express yourself fluently and flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes, and write well-structured text on complex topics.

id.title: Mahir
id.description: Memahami teks panjang yang menantang beserta makna tersiratnya, berekspresi lancar dan fleksibel untuk keperluan sosial, akademik dan profesional, serta menulis teks terstruktur tentang topik kompleks.

nodes.title: Inversion for Emphasis
nodes.summary: Use negative inversion (Never have I…, Not only… but also) and inverted conditionals (Had I known…, Should you need…) for emphasis.
nodes.canDo: Can use inversion after negative expressions and in conditionals to add emphasis and formality.

objectives.text: Use negative inversion for emphasis (Never have I…, Not only… but also…, Rarely do we…)
Use inverted conditionals (Had I known…, Should you need…, Were it not for…)
Recognise when inversion suits the context (formal writing, speeches) and when it sounds unnatural

commonErrors.wrong: Never I have seen such a mess.
commonErrors.right: Never have I seen such a mess.

commonErrors.wrong: Not only she speaks French, but also Spanish.
commonErrors.right: Not only does she speak French, but she also speaks Spanish.

commonErrors.wrong: If had I known, I would have come.
commonErrors.right: Had I known, I would have come.

id.title: Inversi untuk Penekanan
id.summary: Memakai inversi negatif (Never have I…, Not only… but also) dan conditional dengan inversi (Had I known…, Should you need…) untuk penekanan.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai inversi setelah ungkapan negatif dan dalam conditional untuk memberi penekanan dan kesan formal.

objectives.use-negative-inversion: Memakai inversi negatif untuk penekanan (Never have I…, Not only… but also…, Rarely do we…)
objectives.use-inverted-conditionals: Memakai conditional dengan inversi (Had I known…, Should you need…, Were it not for…)
objectives.choose-when-to-invert: Mengenali kapan inversi cocok (tulisan formal, pidato) dan kapan terdengar tidak alami

nodes.title: Cleft Sentences
nodes.summary: Highlight key information with what-clefts, it-clefts and all/the thing that… structures.
nodes.canDo: Can use cleft sentences to highlight key information and to correct misunderstandings.

objectives.text: Use what-clefts to focus information (What I need is more time.)
Use it-clefts to highlight a person, thing or time (It was Sari who called.)
Use all/the thing that… clefts (All I want is…, The thing that worries me is…)

commonErrors.wrong: What I need it is more time.
commonErrors.right: What I need is more time.

commonErrors.wrong: It was Sari she called me.
commonErrors.right: It was Sari who called me.

commonErrors.wrong: All what I want is some peace.
commonErrors.right: All I want is some peace.

id.title: Cleft Sentences
id.summary: Menonjolkan informasi penting dengan what-cleft, it-cleft dan struktur all/the thing that….
id.canDo: Bisa memakai cleft sentence untuk menonjolkan informasi penting dan meluruskan salah paham.

objectives.what-cleft: Memakai what-cleft untuk memfokuskan informasi (What I need is more time.)
objectives.it-cleft: Memakai it-cleft untuk menonjolkan orang, benda atau waktu (It was Sari who called.)
objectives.all-thing-cleft: Memakai cleft dengan all/the thing that… (All I want is…, The thing that worries me is…)

nodes.title: Nominalisation & Noun Phrases
nodes.summary: Turn verbs and adjectives into nouns and build complex noun phrases for a formal, academic style.
nodes.canDo: Can use nominalisation and complex noun phrases to write in a concise, formal and academic style.

objectives.text: Turn verbs and adjectives into nouns (decide → the decision to…, important → the importance of…)
Build complex noun phrases (a significant increase in online sales)
Rewrite everyday sentences in a formal, academic style using nominalisation

commonErrors.wrong: The decide to close the office was difficult.
commonErrors.right: The decision to close the office was difficult.

commonErrors.wrong: There was a significant increase of sales.
commonErrors.right: There was a significant increase in sales.

commonErrors.wrong: The increasing of prices worries people.
commonErrors.right: The increase in prices worries people.

id.title: Nominalisasi & Frasa Kata Benda
id.summary: Mengubah kata kerja dan kata sifat menjadi kata benda serta menyusun frasa kata benda yang kompleks untuk gaya formal dan akademik.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai nominalisasi dan frasa kata benda kompleks untuk menulis dengan gaya ringkas, formal dan akademik.

objectives.verbs-adjectives-to-nouns: Mengubah kata kerja dan kata sifat menjadi kata benda (decide → the decision to…, important → the importance of…)
objectives.complex-noun-phrases: Menyusun frasa kata benda yang kompleks (a significant increase in online sales)
objectives.formal-academic-style: Menulis ulang kalimat sehari-hari dengan gaya formal dan akademik memakai nominalisasi

nodes.title: Impersonal & Advanced Passive
nodes.summary: Report views and claims impersonally: It is thought that…, He is said to have…, There is believed to be….
nodes.canDo: Can report opinions, beliefs and claims impersonally, keeping a formal and objective tone.

objectives.text: Use impersonal it-structures (It is thought/believed/reported that…)
Use subject + passive reporting verb + to-infinitive, including perfect forms (He is said to have left.)
Use there + passive reporting verb + to be (There is believed to be…)

commonErrors.wrong: He is said that he left the company.
commonErrors.right: He is said to have left the company. / It is said that he left the company.

commonErrors.wrong: There is believed to have a problem with the system.
commonErrors.right: There is believed to be a problem with the system.

commonErrors.wrong: The minister is reported resign yesterday.
commonErrors.right: The minister is reported to have resigned yesterday.

id.title: Struktur Impersonal & Passive Lanjutan
id.summary: Melaporkan pendapat dan klaim secara impersonal: It is thought that…, He is said to have…, There is believed to be….
id.canDo: Bisa melaporkan pendapat, keyakinan dan klaim secara impersonal dengan nada formal dan objektif.

objectives.it-is-thought-that: Memakai struktur impersonal dengan it (It is thought/believed/reported that…)
objectives.subject-passive-infinitive: Memakai subjek + kata kerja pelaporan bentuk passive + to-infinitive, termasuk bentuk perfect (He is said to have left.)
objectives.there-is-believed: Memakai there + kata kerja pelaporan bentuk passive + to be (There is believed to be…)

nodes.title: Ellipsis & Substitution
nodes.summary: Avoid repetition with so/not, do so, one/ones and by leaving out repeated words (I'd like to, but I can't).
nodes.canDo: Can avoid unnecessary repetition by substituting or leaving out words, so speech and writing sound natural.

objectives.text: Use so and not to replace a clause (I think so, I hope not, I'm afraid not)
Use do so and one/ones to avoid repeating verbs and nouns
Leave out repeated words naturally (I'd like to, but I can't.)

commonErrors.wrong: A: Is the shop open? B: I think yes.
commonErrors.right: A: Is the shop open? B: I think so.

commonErrors.wrong: A: Will it rain tomorrow? B: I don't hope so.
commonErrors.right: A: Will it rain tomorrow? B: I hope not.

commonErrors.wrong: I wanted to help, but I couldn't do.
commonErrors.right: I wanted to help, but I couldn't.

id.title: Elipsis & Substitusi
id.summary: Menghindari pengulangan dengan so/not, do so, one/ones dan menghilangkan kata yang berulang (I'd like to, but I can't).
id.canDo: Bisa menghindari pengulangan yang tidak perlu dengan mengganti atau menghilangkan kata, sehingga ucapan dan tulisan terdengar alami.

objectives.so-not-substitution: Memakai so dan not untuk menggantikan klausa (I think so, I hope not, I'm afraid not)
objectives.do-so-one-ones: Memakai do so dan one/ones agar tidak mengulang kata kerja dan kata benda
objectives.ellipsis: Menghilangkan kata yang berulang secara alami (I'd like to, but I can't.)

nodes.title: Advanced Participle Clauses
nodes.summary: Use perfect and passive participle clauses and with + noun + -ing, and avoid dangling participles.
nodes.canDo: Can use advanced participle clauses to write compact, well-connected sentences without dangling participles.

objectives.text: Use perfect and passive participle clauses (Having finished…, Having been told…, Built in 1920, …)
Use with + noun + -ing/-ed to add background information (With prices rising, …)
Spot and fix dangling participles

commonErrors.wrong: Arriving late, the meeting had already started.
commonErrors.right: Arriving late, I found that the meeting had already started.

commonErrors.wrong: Having told the news, she started to cry.
commonErrors.right: Having been told the news, she started to cry.

commonErrors.wrong: With the prices rise, people buy less.
commonErrors.right: With prices rising, people are buying less.

id.title: Participle Clause Lanjutan
id.summary: Memakai participle clause bentuk perfect dan passive, with + kata benda + -ing, serta menghindari dangling participle.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai participle clause lanjutan untuk menulis kalimat yang padat dan runtut tanpa dangling participle.

objectives.perfect-passive-participles: Memakai participle clause bentuk perfect dan passive (Having finished…, Having been told…, Built in 1920, …)
objectives.with-noun-ing: Memakai with + kata benda + -ing/-ed untuk menambah informasi latar (With prices rising, …)

nodes.title: Subjunctive & Formal Structures
nodes.summary: Use the subjunctive (It's essential that he be…, I suggest she attend), were-subjunctive and formal should.
nodes.canDo: Can use the subjunctive and other formal structures to make requirements, recommendations and polite offers.

objectives.text: Use the subjunctive after essential/vital/important that… (It's essential that he be on time.)
Use suggest/recommend/insist (that) + base verb (I recommend (that) she attend.)
Use the were-subjunctive (If I were…, as it were) and formal should (Should you have any questions, …)

commonErrors.wrong: I suggest her to attend the meeting.
commonErrors.right: I suggest (that) she attend the meeting.

commonErrors.wrong: It's essential that he will be on time.
commonErrors.right: It's essential that he be on time.

commonErrors.wrong: Should you needed any help, please call me.
commonErrors.right: Should you need any help, please call me.

id.title: Subjunctive & Struktur Formal
id.summary: Memakai subjunctive (It's essential that he be…, I suggest she attend), were-subjunctive dan should formal.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai subjunctive dan struktur formal lain untuk menyampaikan syarat, rekomendasi dan tawaran yang sopan.

objectives.mandative-subjunctive: Memakai subjunctive setelah essential/vital/important that… (It's essential that he be on time.)
objectives.suggest-recommend-that: Memakai suggest/recommend/insist (that) + kata kerja bentuk dasar (I recommend (that) she attend.)
objectives.were-and-formal-should: Memakai were-subjunctive (If I were…, as it were) dan should formal (Should you have any questions, …)

nodes.title: Modal Nuance
nodes.summary: Express fine shades of certainty and obligation: will for assumptions, be bound/likely/supposed to, and past modals.
nodes.canDo: Can use modals and semi-modals precisely to express assumptions, likelihood, expectations and past possibilities.

objectives.text: Use will/won't for confident assumptions (That'll be the courier.)
Use be bound to, be likely to and be supposed to with the right meaning
Distinguish could have, would have, needn't have and didn't need to

commonErrors.wrong: He is bound to coming late.
commonErrors.right: He is bound to come late.

commonErrors.wrong: I needn't have to bring an umbrella.
commonErrors.right: I needn't have brought an umbrella.

commonErrors.wrong: We are supposed to finished by Friday.
commonErrors.right: We are supposed to finish by Friday.

id.title: Nuansa Modal
id.summary: Menyatakan tingkat kepastian dan kewajiban dengan halus: will untuk asumsi, be bound/likely/supposed to, dan modal lampau.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai modal dan semi-modal secara tepat untuk menyatakan asumsi, kemungkinan, harapan dan kemungkinan di masa lalu.

objectives.will-for-assumptions: Memakai will/won't untuk asumsi yang yakin (That'll be the courier.)
objectives.bound-likely-supposed: Memakai be bound to, be likely to dan be supposed to dengan makna yang tepat
objectives.past-modal-nuance: Membedakan could have, would have, needn't have dan didn't need to

nodes.title: Emphasis & Fronting
nodes.summary: Add emphasis with auxiliary do, fronting (Much as I like it, …) and so/such … that, including Such was… that.
nodes.canDo: Can add emphasis and contrast by using emphatic do, fronting and so/such structures.

objectives.text: Use auxiliary do for emphasis and contrast (I do understand, but…)
Front words or clauses for emphasis or contrast (Much as I like it, …; Strange as it may seem, …)
Use so/such … that for emphasis, including fronted forms (Such was the demand that…)

commonErrors.wrong: I do understood your point.
commonErrors.right: I do understand your point. / I did understand your point.

commonErrors.wrong: Much as I like it, but I can't afford it.
commonErrors.right: Much as I like it, I can't afford it.

commonErrors.wrong: It was so a good film that I watched it twice.
commonErrors.right: It was such a good film that I watched it twice.

id.title: Penekanan & Fronting
id.summary: Memberi penekanan dengan auxiliary do, fronting (Much as I like it, …) dan so/such … that, termasuk Such was… that.
id.canDo: Bisa memberi penekanan dan kontras dengan do penegas, fronting dan struktur so/such.

objectives.emphatic-do: Memakai auxiliary do untuk penekanan dan kontras (I do understand, but…)
objectives.fronting: Memindahkan kata atau klausa ke depan untuk penekanan atau kontras (Much as I like it, …; Strange as it may seem, …)
objectives.so-such-emphasis: Memakai so/such … that untuk penekanan, termasuk bentuk yang dipindah ke depan (Such was the demand that…)

nodes.title: Advanced Cohesion & Discourse Markers
nodes.summary: Connect ideas in long texts with formal markers (albeit, notwithstanding), clear reference and signposting.
nodes.canDo: Can produce clear, well-organised long texts using formal connectors, reference words and signposting.

objectives.text: Use formal connectors such as albeit, notwithstanding and insofar as
Refer back clearly with the former/the latter, this approach, such a view
Signpost the structure of long texts (Turning now to…, As outlined above, …)

commonErrors.wrong: Although the plan is risky, but it is worth trying.
commonErrors.right: Although the plan is risky, it is worth trying.

commonErrors.wrong: The plan was effective, albeit it was expensive.
commonErrors.right: The plan was effective, albeit expensive.

commonErrors.wrong: Notwithstanding of the costs, we continued.
commonErrors.right: Notwithstanding the costs, we continued.

id.title: Kohesi & Penanda Wacana Lanjutan
id.summary: Menghubungkan ide dalam teks panjang dengan penanda formal (albeit, notwithstanding), rujukan yang jelas dan signposting.
id.canDo: Bisa menghasilkan teks panjang yang jelas dan tertata dengan kata penghubung formal, kata rujukan dan signposting.

objectives.formal-connectors: Memakai kata penghubung formal seperti albeit, notwithstanding dan insofar as
objectives.reference-devices: Merujuk kembali dengan jelas memakai the former/the latter, this approach, such a view
objectives.signposting: Memberi penanda struktur dalam teks panjang (Turning now to…, As outlined above, …)

nodes.title: Advanced Collocations
nodes.summary: Use strong and academic collocations and delexical verbs, and avoid word-for-word translations from Indonesian.
nodes.canDo: Can use a wide range of natural collocations, including academic ones, instead of literal translations.

objectives.text: Use strong and academic collocations (pose a threat, conduct research, a heavy burden)
Use delexical verbs naturally (make a decision, take a step, have an impact, give a presentation)
Avoid collocations translated word for word from Indonesian

commonErrors.wrong: The project gives a big impact to the community.
commonErrors.right: The project has a big impact on the community.

commonErrors.wrong: We did a research about air pollution.
commonErrors.right: We conducted research into air pollution.

commonErrors.wrong: Climate change raises a serious threat.
commonErrors.right: Climate change poses a serious threat.

id.title: Kolokasi Lanjutan
id.summary: Memakai kolokasi yang kuat dan akademik serta delexical verb, dan menghindari terjemahan kata per kata dari bahasa Indonesia.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai beragam kolokasi yang alami, termasuk kolokasi akademik, bukan terjemahan harfiah.

objectives.use-strong-verbnoun: Memakai kolokasi yang kuat dan akademik (pose a threat, conduct research, a heavy burden)
objectives.delexical-verbs: Memakai delexical verb secara alami (make a decision, take a step, have an impact, give a presentation)
objectives.avoid-direct-translation: Menghindari kolokasi hasil terjemahan kata per kata dari bahasa Indonesia

nodes.title: Academic Word List
nodes.summary: Learn the Academic Word List sublist by sublist, precise reporting verbs (assert, imply, demonstrate) and word families.
nodes.canDo: Can use a broad range of academic vocabulary accurately in study and professional texts.

objectives.text: Learn and use words from the Academic Word List, sublist by sublist
Use precise reporting verbs (assert, imply, demonstrate, argue)
Use academic word families correctly (analyse – analysis – analytical)

commonErrors.wrong: This analyse shows a clear trend.
commonErrors.right: This analysis shows a clear trend.

commonErrors.wrong: The author infers that prices will rise.
commonErrors.right: The author implies that prices will rise.

commonErrors.wrong: The study demonstrates about the effect of sleep.
commonErrors.right: The study demonstrates the effect of sleep.

id.title: Academic Word List
id.summary: Mempelajari Academic Word List per sublist, kata kerja pelaporan yang presisi (assert, imply, demonstrate) dan keluarga kata.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai beragam kosakata akademik dengan tepat dalam teks studi dan profesional.

objectives.awl-sublists: Mempelajari dan memakai kata dari Academic Word List, sublist demi sublist
objectives.precise-reporting-verbs: Memakai kata kerja pelaporan yang presisi (assert, imply, demonstrate, argue)
objectives.academic-word-families: Memakai keluarga kata akademik dengan benar (analyse – analysis – analytical)

nodes.title: Idioms & Fixed Expressions
nodes.summary: Use idioms for work, conflict and success, binomials such as pros and cons, and judge when an idiom fits.
nodes.canDo: Can understand and use common idioms and fixed expressions appropriately in work and everyday conversation.

objectives.text: Understand and use idioms about work, conflict and success (cut corners, clear the air, pay off)
Use binomials and fixed pairs (pros and cons, by and large, sooner or later)
Judge when an idiom fits the situation and tone, and when plain language is better

commonErrors.wrong: Let's look at the cons and pros.
commonErrors.right: Let's look at the pros and cons.

commonErrors.wrong: The exam was a piece of cakes.
commonErrors.right: The exam was a piece of cake.

commonErrors.wrong: We played a game to break ice.
commonErrors.right: We played a game to break the ice.

id.title: Idiom & Ungkapan Tetap
id.summary: Memakai idiom seputar kerja, konflik dan kesuksesan, binomial seperti pros and cons, dan menilai kapan idiom cocok dipakai.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami dan memakai idiom serta ungkapan tetap yang umum secara tepat dalam percakapan kerja dan sehari-hari.

objectives.themed-idioms: Memahami dan memakai idiom seputar kerja, konflik dan kesuksesan (cut corners, clear the air, pay off)
objectives.binomials: Memakai binomial dan pasangan kata tetap (pros and cons, by and large, sooner or later)
objectives.use-idioms-appropriately: Menilai kapan idiom cocok dengan situasi dan nada, dan kapan bahasa biasa lebih baik

nodes.title: Precision & Connotation
nodes.summary: Choose between synonyms with different connotations, replace general words with precise ones and match word choice to tone.
nodes.canDo: Can choose words precisely, taking connotation and tone into account.

objectives.text: Distinguish synonyms with different connotations (slim/skinny, firm/stubborn, thrifty/stingy)
Replace general words with precise ones (good → effective, reliable, valuable)
Choose words that match the tone and purpose of a text

commonErrors.wrong: Your grandmother looks skinny and beautiful.
commonErrors.right: Your grandmother looks slim and beautiful.

commonErrors.wrong: Our manager is stubborn, which really helps the team.
commonErrors.right: Our manager is firm, which really helps the team.

commonErrors.wrong: The new method is very good.
commonErrors.right: The new method is highly effective.

id.title: Ketepatan & Konotasi
id.summary: Memilih sinonim dengan konotasi yang berbeda, mengganti kata umum dengan kata yang presisi, dan menyesuaikan pilihan kata dengan nada.
id.canDo: Bisa memilih kata dengan tepat sambil memperhatikan konotasi dan nada.

objectives.connotation-synonyms: Membedakan sinonim dengan konotasi berbeda (slim/skinny, firm/stubborn, thrifty/stingy)
objectives.precise-words: Mengganti kata umum dengan kata yang presisi (good → effective, reliable, valuable)
objectives.match-word-to-tone: Memilih kata yang sesuai dengan nada dan tujuan teks

nodes.title: Hedging & Softening
nodes.summary: Soften claims and show how certain you are: tend to, it would appear, arguably.
nodes.canDo: Can soften claims and express exactly how certain they are, as expected in academic and professional English.

objectives.text: Soften claims with hedging language (tend to, it would appear, arguably)
Express degrees of certainty (almost certainly, it is likely that, there is little evidence that)

commonErrors.wrong: This proves that social media causes depression.
commonErrors.right: This suggests that social media may contribute to depression.

commonErrors.wrong: It may possibly perhaps be true.
commonErrors.right: It may be true.

id.title: Hedging & Pelunakan
id.summary: Melunakkan klaim dan menunjukkan seberapa yakin kamu: tend to, it would appear, arguably.
id.canDo: Bisa melunakkan klaim dan menyatakan tingkat kepastian secara tepat, seperti yang diharapkan dalam bahasa Inggris akademik dan profesional.

objectives.soften-claims-with: Melunakkan klaim dengan bahasa hedging (tend to, it would appear, arguably)
objectives.express-degrees-of: Menyatakan tingkat kepastian (almost certainly, it is likely that, there is little evidence that)

nodes.title: Prosody for Emphasis & Persuasion
nodes.summary: Use pitch range, pauses and sentence stress to emphasise, persuade and change meaning in long sentences.
nodes.canDo: Can vary pitch, pausing and stress to emphasise key points and sound persuasive.

objectives.text: Widen pitch range to highlight key words and contrasts
Use pauses for effect and to group ideas into clear chunks
Move sentence stress to change meaning in long sentences (I didn't say HE took it.)

commonErrors.wrong: Every word said at the same pitch and volume (flat delivery)
commonErrors.right: Key words raised in pitch and lengthened, other words reduced

commonErrors.wrong: Pausing in the middle of a phrase: a significant | increase in sales
commonErrors.right: Pausing between thought groups: a significant increase in sales | over the last year

commonErrors.wrong: Stressing every word equally, so the contrast is lost
commonErrors.right: Stressing the contrast word: I said TUESDAY, not Thursday

id.title: Prosodi untuk Penekanan & Persuasi
id.summary: Memakai rentang nada, jeda dan tekanan kalimat untuk menekankan, meyakinkan dan mengubah makna dalam kalimat panjang.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatur nada, jeda dan tekanan untuk menekankan poin penting dan terdengar meyakinkan.

objectives.pitch-range: Memperlebar rentang nada untuk menonjolkan kata kunci dan kontras
objectives.pausing-for-effect: Memakai jeda untuk efek dan untuk mengelompokkan ide menjadi potongan yang jelas
objectives.meaning-changing-stress: Memindahkan tekanan kalimat untuk mengubah makna dalam kalimat panjang (I didn't say HE took it.)

nodes.title: Varieties of English
nodes.summary: Understand UK, US, Australian, Indian, Singaporean and Nigerian English, and communicate in English as a lingua franca.
nodes.canDo: Can understand speakers of different varieties of English and communicate effectively with other non-native speakers.

objectives.text: Understand speakers of UK, US, Australian, Indian, Singaporean and Nigerian English
Recognise key pronunciation features of each variety (e.g. whether r after a vowel is pronounced)
Communicate clearly when English is a lingua franca between non-native speakers

id.title: Ragam Bahasa Inggris
id.summary: Memahami bahasa Inggris ragam Inggris, Amerika, Australia, India, Singapura dan Nigeria, serta berkomunikasi dengan bahasa Inggris sebagai lingua franca.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami penutur berbagai ragam bahasa Inggris dan berkomunikasi efektif dengan sesama penutur non-native.

objectives.understand-accents: Memahami penutur bahasa Inggris ragam Inggris, Amerika, Australia, India, Singapura dan Nigeria
objectives.variety-features: Mengenali ciri pelafalan utama tiap ragam (misalnya apakah r setelah vokal diucapkan)
objectives.english-lingua-franca: Berkomunikasi dengan jelas saat bahasa Inggris menjadi lingua franca antar-penutur non-native

nodes.title: Listening for Implicit Meaning
nodes.summary: Pick up attitudes and implied meaning, follow unstructured talk such as panels and interviews, and take lecture notes.
nodes.canDo: Can follow extended, unstructured speech and understand attitudes and meaning that are only implied.

objectives.text: Infer speakers' attitudes and implied meaning (irony, understatement, reluctance)
Follow unstructured speech such as panel discussions and interviews
Take useful notes during lectures

id.title: Menyimak Makna Tersirat
id.summary: Menangkap sikap dan maksud tersirat, mengikuti pembicaraan tidak terstruktur seperti panel dan wawancara, serta mencatat kuliah.
id.canDo: Bisa mengikuti pembicaraan panjang yang tidak terstruktur dan memahami sikap serta makna yang hanya tersirat.

objectives.attitude-implied-meaning: Menangkap sikap dan maksud tersirat pembicara (ironi, understatement, keengganan)
objectives.unstructured-speech: Mengikuti pembicaraan tidak terstruktur seperti diskusi panel dan wawancara
objectives.lecture-note-taking: Membuat catatan yang berguna saat kuliah

nodes.title: Complex & Specialised Texts
nodes.summary: Read academic papers, reports and terms and conditions, analyse argument structure and bias, and read critically.
nodes.canDo: Can understand long, complex and specialised texts in detail and evaluate them critically.

objectives.text: Read academic papers, reports and terms and conditions in detail
Identify the structure of an argument and the writer's bias
Read critically: evaluate evidence, claims and assumptions

id.title: Teks Kompleks & Khusus
id.summary: Membaca paper akademik, laporan dan syarat & ketentuan, menganalisis struktur argumen dan bias, serta membaca secara kritis.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami teks panjang, kompleks dan khusus secara detail serta menilainya secara kritis.

objectives.specialised-texts: Membaca paper akademik, laporan dan syarat & ketentuan secara detail
objectives.argument-and-bias: Mengenali struktur argumen dan bias penulis
objectives.critical-reading: Membaca secara kritis: menilai bukti, klaim dan asumsi

nodes.title: Debate & Argumentation
nodes.summary: Build and rebut arguments, respond to challenges on the spot, and concede a point before countering it.
nodes.canDo: Can build and defend a complex argument, respond spontaneously to challenges and counter opposing views.

objectives.text: Build arguments and rebut opposing ones
Respond spontaneously to challenges and follow-up questions
Concede a point and then counter it (That's a fair point, but…)

id.title: Debat & Argumentasi
id.summary: Membangun dan membantah argumen, menanggapi tantangan secara spontan, serta mengakui poin lawan sebelum membalasnya.
id.canDo: Bisa membangun dan mempertahankan argumen yang kompleks, menanggapi tantangan secara spontan dan membalas pandangan yang berbeda.

objectives.build-rebut-arguments: Membangun argumen dan membantah argumen lawan
objectives.respond-spontaneously: Menanggapi tantangan dan pertanyaan lanjutan secara spontan
objectives.concede-and-counter: Mengakui satu poin lalu membalasnya (That's a fair point, but…)

nodes.title: Persuasive Presentations
nodes.summary: Give persuasive presentations with storytelling, speak without a script and handle difficult questions.
nodes.canDo: Can give a clear, persuasive presentation without a script and handle difficult questions with confidence.

objectives.text: Use storytelling to engage and persuade an audience
Present from brief notes, without reading a script
Handle difficult questions calmly and diplomatically

id.title: Presentasi Persuasif
id.summary: Membawakan presentasi persuasif dengan storytelling, berbicara tanpa naskah dan menghadapi pertanyaan sulit.
id.canDo: Bisa membawakan presentasi yang jelas dan persuasif tanpa naskah serta menghadapi pertanyaan sulit dengan percaya diri.

objectives.storytelling: Memakai storytelling untuk menarik perhatian dan meyakinkan audiens
objectives.present-without-script: Presentasi dengan catatan singkat, tanpa membaca naskah
objectives.handle-tough-questions: Menghadapi pertanyaan sulit dengan tenang dan diplomatis

nodes.title: Leading Meetings
nodes.summary: Open a meeting and set the agenda, manage discussion and conflict, and steer the group towards a decision.
nodes.canDo: Can chair a meeting effectively, keeping discussion on track, handling disagreement and reaching decisions.

objectives.text: Open a meeting and set the agenda
Manage the discussion and handle conflict
Steer the discussion towards a decision and agree next steps

id.title: Memimpin Rapat
id.summary: Membuka rapat dan mengatur agenda, mengelola diskusi dan konflik, serta mengarahkan kelompok ke sebuah keputusan.
id.canDo: Bisa memimpin rapat dengan efektif: menjaga diskusi tetap fokus, menangani perbedaan pendapat dan mencapai keputusan.

objectives.steer-to-decision: Mengarahkan diskusi ke sebuah keputusan dan menyepakati langkah berikutnya

nodes.title: Negotiation
nodes.summary: Make and respond to proposals, concede and bargain diplomatically, and close the deal.
nodes.canDo: Can negotiate diplomatically, making and responding to proposals, bargaining and reaching an agreement.

objectives.text: Make and respond to proposals
Concede and bargain diplomatically
Close a deal and confirm what has been agreed

id.title: Negosiasi
id.summary: Membuat dan menanggapi usulan, mengalah dan menawar secara diplomatis, lalu menutup kesepakatan.
id.canDo: Bisa bernegosiasi secara diplomatis: membuat dan menanggapi usulan, menawar dan mencapai kesepakatan.

objectives.close-the-deal: Menutup kesepakatan dan menegaskan apa yang sudah disepakati

nodes.title: Academic Writing
nodes.summary: Build a coherent argument, paraphrase and reference sources, and write argumentative essays at IELTS Task 2 band 7+.
nodes.canDo: Can write clear, well-structured academic texts that develop an argument and use sources appropriately.

objectives.text: Build a coherent argument
Paraphrase and reference sources
Write an argumentative essay of at least 250 words that meets IELTS Writing Task 2 band 7+ criteria

commonErrors.wrong: Copying a sentence from a source without quotation marks or a reference
commonErrors.right: Paraphrase the idea in your own words and cite the source (Author, year)

id.title: Menulis Akademik
id.summary: Membangun argumen yang koheren, memparafrasekan dan merujuk sumber, serta menulis essay argumentatif setara IELTS Task 2 band 7+.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis teks akademik yang jelas dan terstruktur, mengembangkan argumen dan memakai sumber dengan tepat.

objectives.argumentative-essay: Menulis essay argumentatif minimal 250 kata yang memenuhi kriteria IELTS Writing Task 2 band 7+

nodes.title: Proposals & Reports
nodes.summary: Structure proposals and reports, write executive summaries and recommendations, and keep business writing concise.
nodes.canDo: Can write well-structured proposals and reports with a clear executive summary and recommendations.

objectives.text: Structure a proposal (background, objectives, plan, budget, timeline)
Write an executive summary and clear recommendations
Write concise business text by cutting filler and wordy phrases

commonErrors.wrong: In order to be able to make a decision regarding the matter of the budget…
commonErrors.right: To decide on the budget…

id.title: Proposal & Laporan
id.summary: Menyusun proposal dan laporan, menulis executive summary dan rekomendasi, serta menulis bisnis secara ringkas.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis proposal dan laporan yang terstruktur dengan executive summary dan rekomendasi yang jelas.

objectives.proposal-structure: Menyusun struktur proposal (latar belakang, tujuan, rencana, anggaran, jadwal)
objectives.executive-summary: Menulis executive summary dan rekomendasi yang jelas
objectives.concise-business-writing: Menulis teks bisnis yang ringkas dengan membuang kata pengisi dan frasa bertele-tele

nodes.title: Register Shifting
nodes.summary: Move between formal, neutral and informal English to suit the audience and the channel.
nodes.canDo: Can adjust register to suit the audience, purpose and channel, from formal reports to casual messages.

objectives.text: Adapt register to audience and channel
Rewrite the same message in formal, neutral and informal register

commonErrors.wrong: Hey Mr Tan, wanna catch up about the contract?
commonErrors.right: Dear Mr Tan, would you be available to discuss the contract?

id.title: Pergeseran Register
id.summary: Berpindah antara bahasa Inggris formal, netral dan informal sesuai audiens dan media.
id.canDo: Bisa menyesuaikan register dengan audiens, tujuan dan media, dari laporan formal sampai pesan santai.

objectives.adapt-register-to: Menyesuaikan register dengan audiens dan media
objectives.rewrite-across-registers: Menulis ulang pesan yang sama dalam register formal, netral dan informal

nodes.title: Synthesising Sources & Mediating
nodes.summary: Combine Indonesian and English sources into one summary, mediate disagreements and explain cultural concepts.
nodes.canDo: Can synthesise information from several sources, mediate between people with different views and explain cultural nuances.

objectives.text: Synthesise several sources (Indonesian and English) into one English summary
Mediate differences of opinion within a team
Convey nuance and cultural concepts such as gotong royong and sungkan in English

id.title: Menyintesis Sumber & Mediasi
id.summary: Menggabungkan sumber berbahasa Indonesia dan Inggris jadi satu ringkasan, memediasi perbedaan pendapat dan menjelaskan konsep budaya.
id.canDo: Bisa menyintesis informasi dari beberapa sumber, menjembatani orang dengan pandangan berbeda dan menjelaskan nuansa budaya.

objectives.synthesise-sources: Menyintesis beberapa sumber (bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris) menjadi satu ringkasan berbahasa Inggris
objectives.explain-cultural-concepts: Menyampaikan nuansa dan konsep budaya seperti gotong royong dan sungkan dalam bahasa Inggris

nodes.title: C1 Checkpoint
nodes.summary: A mixed test of every C1 strand in a format similar to C1 Advanced and IELTS band 7+.
nodes.canDo: Can show C1-level skills across grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing and mediation.

objectives.text: Grammar and vocabulary: inversion, clefts, nominalisation, collocations and hedging in context
Reading and listening: long, complex texts and unscripted speech, including implied meaning
Writing and speaking: an essay or report and a spoken discussion, scored with a rubric
Mediation: summarise information from several sources for a given audience

id.title: Checkpoint C1
id.summary: Tes campuran semua strand C1 dengan format mirip C1 Advanced dan IELTS band 7+.
id.canDo: Bisa menunjukkan kemampuan level C1 dalam grammar, kosakata, listening, reading, speaking, writing dan mediasi.

objectives.grammar-vocabulary: Grammar dan kosakata: inversi, cleft sentence, nominalisasi, kolokasi dan hedging dalam konteks
objectives.reading-listening: Reading dan listening: teks panjang yang kompleks dan ucapan tanpa naskah, termasuk makna tersirat
objectives.writing-speaking: Writing dan speaking: essay atau laporan dan diskusi lisan, dinilai dengan rubrik
objectives.mediation: Mediasi: meringkas informasi dari beberapa sumber untuk audiens tertentu
